children: MarketAxess filed to reinitiate HSR review, pushing the waiting period to expire Oct. 29, 2026 before its Oct. 29 special stockholder meeting.
MarketAxess and ICE withdrew and refiled HSR notifications; new waiting period now set to expire 11:59 p.m. ET on Oct. 29, 2026.
Refiling gives DOJ additional review time and could be extended by a request for more information or agreement of the parties.
Merger completion remains subject to HSR expiration, MarketAxess stockholder approval and satisfaction or waiver of other closing conditions.
MarketAxess expects the merger to close in the first half of 2027 if conditions are met; special stockholder meeting set for Oct. 29, 2026.
